summary: Describes uses and conventions for IETF working groups considering GitHub, such as setting up and administering repositories and teams. It does not mandate any process and does not require changes for groups that do not use GitHub. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If a team uses a shared website for its work, someone must set it up and manage who can do what. This document explains how that setup and management usually goes.

questions: how to administer a working group github organization
